name: B10-0540/2026 (S&D) – The illegal Türkiye–Libya Memorandum of Understanding and infringement of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the illegal Türkiye-Libya Memorandum of Understanding and infringement of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Libya's approval of a 2019 sea borders deal with Türkiye. Parliament says the deal is legally void because it ignores international sea law and cuts into the sea areas of Greece and Egypt. It asks Libya to cancel the deal and Türkiye to stop acting on it. It also asks the European Union to keep sanctions ready and to protect shared energy projects. This is Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament urges Libya to cancel the deal and Türkiye to stop acting on it.
- **Who it affects:** Libya, Türkiye, Greece, Cyprus, Egypt, and EU energy projects at sea.
- **What happens next:** EU governments decide whether to renew sanctions expiring 30 November 2026.
